name: GuardianModelAdaptation
details: Guardian's daily model-adaptation run: probes the enabled model (a warm-up call, tokens per character, usable context window, tool-call and structured-output support) and saves a trustworthy result to the guardian_model_profile List, which every investigation reads for its input budget and tool-list budget. A probe that was not trustworthy leaves the previous profile in place. Makes a few dozen small billable model calls per run. Runs a playbook that calls !guardian-probe-model then !GuardianModelProfileUpdate -- no incident-scoped state is needed.
